original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

original_customer_context.original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

refined_task: As of 2025-11-30, estimate recorded fulfilled positive product-unit sales for the next seven days and supplier lead time plus seven-day review horizon; subtract usable stock and eligible dated inbound once; add supplied safety stock; round positive requirements to supplied minimum and pack rules. Export every supported product at a store, including zero orders, and pre-arrival shortage flags. Deliver a parameterized non-LLM weekly CLI.
supplied_facts: 336 policy rows and stock positions effective 2025-11-30
October-November are development evidence; December forbidden
interpretations: Positive completed or shipped quantities are the clearest available fulfilled-sales proxy
Returns do not establish reusable stock; do not credit them again against supplied usable inventory
Missing transaction entries may be zero recorded sales in a continuously observed ledger, not proof of zero demand or store opening
unknowns: Historical status changes and logging completeness
Availability versus excess-stock priority, costs and prices appropriate to ordering
candidate_discovery: Recent means are transparent baselines but sparse series make short windows noisy. A longer mean can stabilize them. Pooled penalized Poisson regression can share recurring annual patterns while retaining product-at-store intercepts, uses nonnegative count-like targets and sparse CPU computation. Inspect the released transactions and profile code as evidence; no external claims needed.
outcome_proxies: Forecast absolute recorded-unit error supports quantity estimation, not proven availability, savings or purchasing cost. The routine replaces repeated aggregation, forecasting, subtraction and pack rounding; no exact prior workflow or hours saved are asserted.
engineering_gate: Development selection only. No externally declared meaningful improvement threshold or untouched evaluation is available; performance-success readiness remains open. Do not access December.
